Who we find

Interim directors and senior managers
Someone to take responsibility for staff, budgets, and decisions until a permanent appointment or a handover.
Programme and project leads
Someone to run a programme, agree who will do each part of the work, and deal with delays.
Analysts and service improvement specialists
Someone to investigate how a service works, where people get stuck, or how it could be organised differently.
